questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the fastest legal speed you can drive on this road. In bad weather like rain, snow, or ice, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It warns you that the upcoming bridge is narrow and you may not be able to safely pass or meet a truck there. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic light. It tells left-turning drivers that they do not have the right-of-way. You must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down and check for traffic and pedestrians. Give the right-of-way to any cross traffic. Only stop if you need to.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show sharp curves in the direction the arrow points. This one points left, so the road curves sharply left. Multiple chevron signs may be placed along a curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This pennant-shaped sign is only used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: On vertical traffic lights, red is on top and green is on bottom. On horizontal traffic lights, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate when riding in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: On roads with two or more lanes, make room for vehicles entering your road. Move to another lane if it is safe and no one is driving there.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that these parking spaces are only for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming road conditions or hazards. They are usually yellow and black. This sign warns that a lane is ending and drivers must be ready to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Let vehicles and pedestrians in or near the intersection go first. Then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs are stop signs. You must stop and give the right-of-way to other traffic at an intersection. Proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane is ending. Traffic in the right lane must move to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will turn sharply to the right first, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Look for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves right ahead. Slow down to the speed shown (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet. Drive carefully in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
Operators may turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you can either turn right or go straight ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill section of road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you to drive carefully when the road is wet because it becomes slippery and harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet. Drive carefully in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down and be ready to stop at the intersection. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road has multiple curves. Adjust your speed and stay alert.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a winding road with three or more curves is ahead.
